title: Jeremiah Bible Quiz - Chapter 35
description: Ten questions on Jeremiah 35: the Rechabites brought into Yahweh's house, their refusal to drink wine, and the promise made to the house of Jonadab.

questions.text: In whose days did this word come to Jeremiah from Yahweh?
questions.explanation: The word came to Jeremiah from Yahweh in the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah, king of Judah.

answers.text: In the days of Jehoiakim the son of Josiah
In the days of Zedekiah the son of Josiah
In the days of Coniah the son of Jehoiakim
In the days of Josiah the son of Amon

questions.text: Which house was Jeremiah told to go to and bring into Yahweh's house?
questions.explanation: Yahweh told Jeremiah to go to the house of the Rechabites, speak to them, bring them into one of the rooms of Yahweh's house and give them wine to drink.

answers.text: The house of the princes of Judah
The house of Shaphan the scribe
The house of the Rechabites
The house of the keeper of the threshold

questions.text: What did Jeremiah set before the sons of the house of the Rechabites, and what did he say?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah set before them bowls full of wine, and cups, and said to them, "Drink wine!"

answers.text: Bread and oil, and said, "Eat!"
Bowls full of wine and cups, and said, "Drink wine!"
Meal offerings, and said, "Offer them!"
Water and summer fruits, and said, "Take and eat!"

questions.text: Why did the Rechabites say they would drink no wine?
questions.explanation: They said that Jonadab the son of Rechab, their father, had commanded them that they and their sons should drink no wine forever.

answers.text: Because the priests had forbidden it to them in Yahweh's house at Jerusalem
Because they were keeping a fast before Yahweh
Because the king had commanded it that year
Because Jonadab the son of Rechab, their father, had commanded it

questions.text: Whom did Jeremiah take with him, along with his brothers and all his sons?
questions.explanation: Jeremiah took Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah, the son of Habazziniah, with his brothers, all his sons, and the whole house of the Rechabites.

answers.text: Jaazaniah the son of Jeremiah
Hanan the son of Igdaliah
Maaseiah the son of Shallum
Gemariah the son of Shaphan

questions.text: Besides drinking no wine, what else had Jonadab commanded his sons?
questions.explanation: Jonadab commanded them not to build a house, sow seed, plant a vineyard or have any, but to dwell in tents all their days.

answers.text: To keep the new moons and the sabbaths in Yahweh's house forever
To carry no silver or gold with them
To live in tents, not building houses or planting vineyards
To offer sacrifice only in Yahweh's house

questions.text: Why had the Rechabites come to live at Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: They said that when Nebuchadnezzar king of Babylon came up into the land, they went to Jerusalem for fear of the army of the Chaldeans and the army of the Syrians.

answers.text: Because a famine had come on all the land where they lived as nomads
For fear of the army of the Chaldeans and of the Syrians
Because the king had summoned them to the city
To bring their offerings at the fast day

questions.text: Whom had Yahweh sent to his people, rising up early and sending them?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he had sent all his servants the prophets to them, rising up early and sending them, telling each to return from his evil way, but they had not listened.

answers.text: The Levitical priests
Messengers from the nations
The princes of Jerusalem
All his servants the prophets

questions.text: What did Yahweh say he would bring on Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said he would bring on Judah and all the inhabitants of Jerusalem all the evil that he had pronounced against them, because he had spoken and called but they had not heard or answered.

answers.text: All the evil that he had pronounced against them
A famine of seven years in the land
A new covenant written in their hearts
The sword of the king of Egypt

questions.text: What did Yahweh of Armies promise the house of the Rechabites, because they had obeyed their father?
questions.explanation: Because they had obeyed the commandment of Jonadab their father, Yahweh said that Jonadab the son of Rechab would not lack a man to stand before Yahweh forever.

answers.text: That they would be given fields and vineyards
That Jonadab would not lack a man to stand before Yahweh forever
That they would be made priests in Yahweh's house
That their tents would never be moved out of the land they lived in
